description: Flip one or more fair coins and get heads or tails, with the tally. Cryptographically random, not Math.random. For tie-breaks and A/B splits an agent has to decide on its own. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

count.description: How many coins to flip, 1-100. Defaults to 1.
